option.SearchKeywords: qud expanded mutation points mutant chargen
option.helptext:
How many mutation points a Mutated Human starts character creation with.
Vanilla Caves of Qud gives 12. Caves of Qud Expanded has always given 16, which is the default here.
Set this before creating a character. Changing it has no effect on a character that already exists.

option.SearchKeywords: qud expanded starting skills chargen cooking staunch wounds
option.helptext:
Grants Mutated Humans and True Kin the extra starting skills this mod has always given: Staunch Wounds, Cooking and Gathering, and Meal Preparation. Mutated Humans also get Menacing Stare.
Turn this off to start with exactly vanilla's skills. Vanilla's own starting skills are never removed.
Psionic Adepts are unaffected. Their starting skills are not an addition to a vanilla genotype - they are all the genotype has.
Set this before creating a character.

option.SearchKeywords: qud expanded starting reputation joppa faction chargen
option.helptext:
Gives Mutated Humans {{G|+300}} reputation with Joppa at character creation.
{{y|Off by default}}, unlike the rest of this mod. It grants power with nothing attached to use it, so it is the kind of change you should have to ask for rather than opt out of.
True Kin keep their vanilla Templar standing either way, and Psionic Adepts keep their Mechanimist standing.
Set this before creating a character.
